flows: subscription/module changes reflected in backoffice and portals

gaps.title: Password recovery codes are temporary passwords
gaps.currentBehavior: Short recovery codes are written as Supabase Auth passwords.

gaps.title: Reset completion accepts any authenticated session
gaps.currentBehavior: Password reset completion updates the current authenticated user without recovery-context binding.

gaps.title: Platform admin terminal guard is not host-bound
gaps.currentBehavior: Platform admin guards check role but not platform host at the terminal guard.

gaps.title: Platform MFA/AAL enforcement is not implemented
gaps.currentBehavior: Platform status reports MFA as later and privileged guards do not enforce MFA/AAL.

gaps.title: Platform invite and bootstrap can overwrite existing auth users
gaps.currentBehavior: Existing Auth users can have password or metadata changed by privileged onboarding paths.

gaps.title: Archived tenants can be reactivated
gaps.currentBehavior: Reactivate sets status active without checking suspended-only state or clearing archive metadata.

gaps.title: Lifecycle updates are not coupled to audit or zero-row checks
gaps.currentBehavior: Lifecycle mutation and audit are separate and update result cardinality is not checked.

gaps.title: Reserved-domain checks do not protect root/future hosts consistently
gaps.currentBehavior: Validation rejects configured platform hosts but not every root or future reserved host.

gaps.title: Legacy tenant creation bypasses canonical provisioning
gaps.currentBehavior: A still-exported create action inserts partial tenant records without delegating to provisionTenant.

gaps.title: Safe deletion/offboarding is not productized
gaps.currentBehavior: Provisioning rollback cleanup exists, but no tenant offboarding readiness workflow exists.

gaps.title: Tenant sector policy is not enforced on core sector writes
gaps.currentBehavior: Sector helpers exist but core and portal writes accept raw active sector IDs.

gaps.flow: subscription/module changes reflected in backoffice and portals
gaps.title: Module overrides can outlive plan changes
gaps.currentBehavior: Tenant module rows override plan modules, and plan changes do not reconcile those overrides.

gaps.title: Onboarding can silently expand tenant scope
gaps.currentBehavior: No module or sector selections are warnings while provisioning falls back to broad defaults.

gaps.title: First-run completion is readiness tracking, not enforcement
gaps.currentBehavior: Manual first-run completion can mark required steps complete without backing records.

gaps.title: Domain-event recipients are not tenant-bound
gaps.currentBehavior: Domain events select personnel/customers by submitted ID and active status without tenant predicate.

gaps.title: Personnel ticket and message identity is not current-tenant bound
gaps.currentBehavior: Personnel PWA identity is resolved by auth user ID without current portal tenant or active-status binding first.

gaps.title: Platform notification dispatch has no backing delivery mutation
gaps.currentBehavior: Dispatch and recipient snapshots are recorded, but no provider-backed e-mail, push, or in-app delivery is invoked.

gaps.title: Global e-mail fallback can use arbitrary tenant SMTP
gaps.currentBehavior: Legacy SMTP fallback selects any enabled organization SMTP row without tenant scope before env Resend.

gaps.title: Request-route permission checks miss support-mode audit
gaps.currentBehavior: hasPermission audits support decisions, but hasPermissionFromRequest does not call the audit helper.

gaps.title: Direct-ID and wrong-tenant misses are isolated but not audited
gaps.currentBehavior: Tenant-filtered misses return null/notFound, but denial events are not audited.

gaps.title: Support grant tables lack database hardening
gaps.currentBehavior: Support grant tables lack the RLS/revoke hardening used by later sensitive-access tables.

gaps.title: Sensitive access requests are not bound to active support grants
gaps.currentBehavior: A platform support user can request sensitive access for a submitted tenant ID without active grant binding.

claimsRequiringRuntimeEvidence: Database transaction and zero-row lifecycle behavior.
RLS or database hardening for support grants and sensitive access.
Browser route behavior for wrong-host and suspended-tenant access.
Provider-safe e-mail, push, and platform notification delivery.
rollback: Revert the audit markdown, gap register, and source-level contract test. No runtime data rollback is required.
